messages:
ana: Heads-up — integration freeze slides to Wed 03/24 12:00 PDT. Changelog cutoff is Wed EOD 03/24. We need explicit owners for: SDK packaging (npm/py), docs sweep, quickstarts, sampleapps, and two changelog editors. Callouts below.

ravi: I can own SDK packaging (npm + python wheel). Will open a packaging PR with a publishing script tweak by Tue 18:00 PST.

emma: Docs sweep here — website guides + quickstart README checks. I'll run an accessibility pass Tue morning and flag any content blockers.

joel: Quickstarts ownership for TS/CLI examples — will verify runtime compatibility and update the runtime note in each README.

sam: Flag: sampleapps CI has a nondeterministic e2e failure (DEVEX-999). I'm reproducing locally and will post logs. Short-term plan: try a retry decorator in the flaky step.

iggy-bot: automated: sampleapps CI flakiness up 14% in 48h. /ci/sampleapps/build/789 — flake pattern suggests a network timeout in the runner.

ravi: If the retry reduces flakes, we can avoid rolling sampleapps into GA. Contingency: gate sampleapps behind canary-only rollout and document in the rollout playbook.

emma: Docs PRs ready for review: #804 (docs fixes), #809 (quickstart examples), #812 (api typing notes). Please leave review comments inline.

joel: Quickstart PRs: #817 (TS quickstart restructure), #820 (CLI usage example). I'll add a small smoke test in the CI matrix.

sam: I'll post a retry-prototype diff by 17:00 and a short benchmark of flake reduction. If it drops below our 3% threshold, we can unblock.

ana: (root) Changelog editing: need two editors for final wording and publishing. One editor should be available Fri morning to publish release notes and tag the release.

ravi: I'll be one editor — will draft SDK & packaging notes and outline upgrade guidance.

marco: I'll be second editor and handle publishing Fri AM. Please drop a PR list in this thread so I can assemble the release notes.

emma: PR list for changelog draft: #804, #809, #812 (docs); #817, #820 (quickstarts); #826 (ts sampleapp fix); #830 (sdk packaging tweak). I'll paste links in the changelog draft later today.

ana: Action items recap:
- SDK packaging owner: @ravi (packaging PR w/ publish script)
- Docs owner: @emma (PRs #804/#809/#812)
- Quickstarts: @joel (PRs #817/#820)
- Sampleapps owner: @sam (investigate DEVEX-999, retry prototype)
- Changelog editors: @ravi + @marco (publish Fri AM)

Please react with :thumbsup: if this matches your understanding. If anything changes, update the thread and the release board (/boards/devexp-release).

ravi: :thumbsup:

emma: :thumbsup: will start the sweep Tue 8am PDT.

sam: investigating now, will update DEVEX-999 with repro steps and ETA.

joel: :thumbsup: will run a quick local smoke on latest runtime tomorrow.

marco: :thumbsup: will reserve publishing slot and prep release note template.

ana: One more note — if sampleapps still fail after retry, we flip to canary-only and publish a short mitigation note in the release notes so customers know what to expect.
